claims.claim_text: 幾乎所有儲存庫的一份副本搬到 Azure
claims.evidence: '99.99999% of the Git repositories on GitHub began living in two places at once'; 'most repositories have two of their five replicas in Azure'

claims.claim_text: 每筆寫入持有整個 repository 的鎖（已改為文章原意：鎖成為吞吐上限，不再連結到最忙儲存庫）
claims.evidence: 'because each write holds a repository-wide lock until it commits, it also sets the throughput ceiling' (link to busiest repos not confirmed; lede reworded)

claims.claim_text: 最慢的健康副本決定每次寫入的延遲
claims.evidence: 'the slowest healthy replica sets the latency of every write'

claims.claim_text: quorum 縮到單一 reference；物件儲存讓讀取獨立擴充
claims.evidence: 'changing the scope of the quorum from the whole repository to individual references'; 'as many virtual read replicas as a repository needs, on demand'

claims.claim_text: P-384 私鑰為 47 個零位元組加一個位元組
claims.evidence: 'the private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were compromised.'; 'That's 47 bytes of zeros and then one byte.'

claims.claim_text: 最多 255 步，筆電上不到一秒
claims.evidence: 'which is at most 255 steps.'; 'on my laptop just now, and it took less than a second.'

claims.claim_text: Chrome 與 Mozilla 自 10 月 17 日起以 CRLSet 與 OneCRL 封鎖
claims.evidence: report 'Saturday, 17 October'; 'Chrome pushed a CRLSet update blocking them that evening'; Mozilla via OneCRL 'a few hours later'

claims.claim_text: 非瀏覽器客戶端預設不檢查撤銷與 CT
claims.evidence: 'don't check revocation by default, and they don't check CT.'

claims.claim_text: 對 TypeScript 7.0、同 worker 數，最高快 8 倍、記憶體少約 70%
claims.evidence: 'compared to TypeScript 7.0'; 'when using the same number of type check workers'; 'up to 8x faster'; '~70% less memory'

claims.claim_text: 文章強調不是分叉
claims.evidence: 'To be clear, we are not forking TypeScript.'

claims.claim_text: Go 編成 Wasm 須連 GC 一起編
claims.evidence: 'When you compile a Go program to Wasm, you have to compile Go's garbage collector along with it.'

claims.claim_text: 十個 HTTP/3 實作中七個易受攻擊
claims.evidence: 'Seven of the ten implementations tested are vulnerable; several are already fixed.'

claims.claim_text: 約 4 KiB 條目、數千個 1 位元組參照
claims.evidence: 'inserts one large entry (~4 KiB) via the encoder stream'; 'references it thousands of times with 1-byte indexed references'

claims.claim_text: lsquic 600–1800 倍、Bun 約 4000 倍
claims.evidence: table wire-to-memory ratio: lsquic '~600-1800x'; Bun '~4000x'

claims.claim_text: 截至 10 月 20 日各實作修補狀態
claims.evidence: patched as of Oct 20, 2026: quic-go 0.57.0, quiche 0.29.3, lsquic 4.9.0; unpatched: Bun 1.4.3, aioquic/mitmproxy

claims.claim_text: 1.19 美元漲到約 2.46 美元
claims.evidence: 'an average review cost a palatable $1.19'; 'By the end of August, that figure had shot up to about $2.46'

claims.claim_text: 最貴兩週平均 2.43 美元降到 0.77 美元，降幅 68%（已補基準說明）
claims.evidence: 'the average review now costs just $0.77, down 68% from the $2.43 it averaged over our two most expensive weeks'

claims.claim_text: 前後比較非對照實驗；效能審查重要發現約少 64%
claims.evidence: 'this isn't a statistically sound controlled experiment.'; 'about 64% fewer important performance issues per review'

claims.claim_text: 共用快取前綴、調整模型與強度
claims.evidence: each session's first request reads 'a shared cached prefix'; model and effort selection credited with more of the savings

claims.claim_text: 路由器零領域工作；14 個子代理
claims.evidence: orchestrator 'performs zero domain work itself.'; 'Fourteen specialized subagents.'

claims.claim_text: 三到四天縮到一小時內；約三分之二不需大幅手改
claims.evidence: 'took three to four days by hand'; 'under an hour'; 'About two-thirds of the system's changes land without significant human edits.'

claims.claim_text: 單一內部系統、無準確率基準
claims.evidence: no accuracy benchmark for Meta's own system; the cited 70-80% / 10-20% figures come from a separate preprint
php.net: 'PHP 8.5.12 Released! ... fixing two critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)'; 20 Oct notice 'both rated CVSS v4.0 9.2'

claims.claim_text: 成因為請求出錯時的記憶體處理
claims.evidence: Cloudflare: 'runs out of memory, PHP fails to clean up the memory safely'; php.net: 'out-of-memory handling can interrupt PHP while internal request data is only partially initialized'

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 稱公開前約 9 小時上線預設規則（已改為歸屬 Cloudflare）
claims.evidence: Cloudflare: 'about 9 hours ahead of public disclosure'; adversarial note: php.net announced release for 21 Oct 14:00 UTC (~11h after 03:02 UTC); lede now attributes the figure to Cloudflare
Cloudflare: 'updating website code or a plugin(s) alone does not fix these vulnerabilities'; php.net: 'PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35 fix two critical vulnerabilities'

claims.claim_text: Michael Tsai 整理「passkey 是陷阱」討論
claims.evidence: mjtsai.com page quotes The Hack's post plus Tsai's commentary and replies from Helme and Mondello

claims.claim_text: 第三方管理器首當其衝（KeePass、Bitwarden 只出現在留言；已改為較小或獨立管理器）
claims.evidence: KeePass/Bitwarden appear only in reader comments; Tsai: 'Smaller credential managers who resisted would be frozen out.' (lede corrected)

claims.claim_text: 疑慮在 attestation 可能限制可用的 passkey 管理器
claims.evidence: The Hack quote: websites 'gradually remove your ability to do as you please with them'; Mondello: 'would freeze out independent, non-corporate-backed credential managers'

claims.claim_text: Helme 與 Mondello 反駁：消費級網站要求 attestation 會擋掉幾乎所有使用者
claims.evidence: Helme: 'it would lock out almost all of its own users, instantly.'; Mondello: 'attestation isn't supported on the web for mass market, consumer authentication.'

claims.claim_text: Tsai 認為多數人採用後風險放大
claims.evidence: Tsai: 'Once most people have adopted passkeys, if Apple and Google sell us out...'

claims.claim_text: DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS 10 月 21 日；支援至少到 2027 年 10 月
claims.evidence: post dated 2026-10-21; 'long-term support (LTS) release with support until at least October 2027'

claims.claim_text: 資料庫檔不相容、PEG 解析器、單箭頭 lambda 預設停用
claims.evidence: 'DuckDB versions before 2.0 cannot read database files created by DuckDB 2.0.'; PEG-based parser default; single-arrow lambda 'disabled by default'

claims.claim_text: 關鍵工作負載可等 11 月首個修補版
claims.evidence: 'if your workload is mission-critical, you may want to wait for the first patch release' (November)

claims.claim_text: 共用不可變 map、比對 map 指標
claims.evidence: 'we don't need to check equality on the fields of the map; just its pointer/numeric ID'; 'a really fast check followed by an indexed load'

claims.claim_text: 作者估計命中與否可差 2 倍以上
claims.evidence: 'the difference between a cache hit and a cache miss in a hot path could be 2x performance or more'

claims.claim_text: 屬性加入順序不同會產生不同 shape
claims.evidence: 'Adding attributes in different orders (e.g. a then b vs b then a) will result in different shapes.'
